name: modrixcommerce/multi-vendor
display_name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace (Vendors, KYB Verification, Seller Catalog & Payouts)
description: Transform your store into a full Multi-Vendor Marketplace with public vendor registration, KYB/KYC business verification badges, dedicated vendor product catalogs and storefronts, automatic order commission splitting, and store-to-vendor payouts.
author: Modrix Commerce

permissions.name: multi_vendor.manage
permissions.label: Manage multi-vendor marketplace, business verifications, seller products & payouts

settings.label: Enable Multi-Vendor Marketplace
settings.help: Activate marketplace vendor storefronts, seller badges, commission splitting, and vendor payouts.

settings.label: Allow Public Vendor Registration & KYB Onboarding
settings.help: Allow prospective sellers to apply and submit business verification credentials at /m/modrixcommerce/multi-vendor/register.

settings.label: Automatically Approve New Vendor Applications
settings.help: When disabled, new vendor registrations start in Pending status until approved by an administrator.

settings.label: Require KYB Business Verification for Vendor Products
settings.help: Require sellers to pass business verification (Trade License / Tax ID / Legal Entity check) before their products auto-publish.

settings.label: Automatically Approve Vendor Catalog Products
settings.help: Automatically publish products created by approved (and verified, if required) marketplace sellers.

settings.label: Default Marketplace Commission Rate (%)
settings.help: Percentage retained by the marketplace store on each vendor order item (can be overridden per vendor or per product).

settings.label: Vendor Payout Mode
settings.help: Choose how vendors receive their net earnings from the marketplace store.

options.label: Vendor Payout Request (Seller requests payout from Seller Portal)
Automatic Payout on Order (Automatically generate payout when balance reaches threshold)
Admin Batch Payouts (Store admin generates scheduled batch payouts)

settings.label: Minimum Payout Threshold Amount
settings.help: Minimum available vendor balance required before a payout can be requested or automatically generated.

settings.label: Payout Transfer Processing Fee (%)
settings.help: Optional percentage fee deducted from vendor payout disbursements.

settings.label: Show Seller Badge on Storefront Product Cards
settings.help: Displays the seller name and Verified Business checkmark on product cards across all storefront themes.

settings.label: Show 'Sold & Fulfilled by Seller' Box on Product Detail Pages
settings.help: Renders the seller profile card, Verified Business badge, rating, and store link on product pages.
